ctx.x: While you were in Korea, at some point were there opportunities for you to play? What other musicians -- there had to be some musicians there.

I was in a supply company of an infantry regiment working supply. I did that for a couple of months. Then I went to audition with the division band. I hiked about ten miles down a Korean road just to audition for this band. I passed the audition, and I was transferred from this supply company to the band. That’s when I had chance to -- I started playing again. While there I met Pepper Adams who --
